## What & why

Briefly describe the change and its motivation.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Benchmark submission (see the leaderboard submission checklist)

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes (or `pytest -q`)
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` is clean
- [ ] New behavior has a regression test
- [ ] Docs/CHANGELOG updated if user-facing
- [ ] For results/metrics changes: multi-seed, mean ± std reported

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know (seeds, benchmark impact, follow-ups).
